_comment: Film 66 Lyria 3.5 prompts (google/lyria-3.5, 0.10 USD per track, 6 tracks, 2026-11-20). Method as Film 59 / 54: one track per chapter; chapters = sections of timing.json (H,1 | 2,3 | M,4 | 5,6 | 7,8 | 9,10,A2 + end screen). Files in /tmp/claude-0/f66/audio/music, not in the repo. Prompt sent = style + ' ' + 'A <len> track. ' + mood.
style: Instrumental underscore for a calm, thoughtful editorial documentary about prices, machines and wages. Mystical and quiet: a night-time market hall after closing, warm lamplight, price tags drifting down one after another like falling leaves. Sparse felt piano, soft celesta and music-box like plucked notes that fall in gentle descending figures, warm low pads, soft low strings, faint airy glassy textures, a little tape warmth. No drums, no percussion, no beat, no vocals, no choir, no melody hook, not pop, not epic, not kitschy, not cinematic trailer. Very quiet, narrow dynamic range, slow, made to sit under a speaking voice.

M0.chapter: H, 1 (everything will get cheap, your receipts, the promise C1, the argument, the test)
M0.mood: curious and warm with a faint mystery: single soft descending celesta notes like price tags slowly falling one after another, a low warm drone underneath, gentle felt piano; an empty market hall at night, something about to change; steady and calm throughout, no build-up

M1.mood: light and thoughtful, a little brighter: delicate plucked notes falling in a slow cascade, airy glassy pads, soft piano; ideas and knowledge becoming nearly free; calm curiosity

M2.chapter: M, 4 (subscribe call, tag 3 things: robots, phones, C2)
M2.mood: warm and patient, slightly more grounded: soft low strings and felt piano, a slow gentle pulse of muted plucked notes without drums, a hint of machinery far away like a quiet factory at night; things get cheaper slowly, not in a straight line

M3.chapter: 5, 6 (tag 4 energy, the floor, C3 radical abundance; tag 5 food, the ground)
M3.mood: deep and contemplative: a low steady warm drone like a hum of electricity, sparse piano notes that stop falling and hover, a faint shimmer of hope in the middle, then earthy and grounded at the end; the floor that does not fall

M4.chapter: 7, 8 (tag 6 housing and land, tag 7 your wage, C4, the second half of the promise)
M4.mood: more serious and weighty, still quiet: dark low strings, slow sustained minor harmonies, sparse low piano, a restrained tension without drama; land that cannot be made, a paycheck that is itself a price; sober and honest, no thriller

M5.chapter: 9, 10, A2 + end screen (three answers, the order, closing call)
M5.mood: warm and gently hopeful: the falling celesta figure returns but slower and resolves upward, warm felt piano over soft strings, a sense of people choosing the rules together; calm, open and human; ends on one long decaying warm major chord
